title: Fielded is obsessed with scammers and unhinged Japanese cyberpunk
summary: Lindsay Powell, who releases records under the name Fielded, has spent most of her career subverting expectations and genre conventions. According to their Bandcamp page, Fielded started as an experimental noise project before growing into something closer to R&B.
